description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkAudioPlayer component, including the implementation of a timeout utility and a WAV data generator used in the tests.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayerTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of TalkAudioPlayer, such as non-hanging playback and handling multiple play calls.

classes.name: TimeoutError
classes.description: A simple error used for signaling a timeout in asynchronous operations.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Runs a suspending task with a specified timeout; throws TimeoutError if the task does not complete in time.

methods.name: makeWav16Mono
methods.description: Generates a WAV format Data object with silence samples for test purposes.
